ad_info.reference_style: Clean two-column benefits ad: the large real bottle standing in front of a tall fuchsia arch on the left and a vertical stack of icon-tile-plus-text benefits on the right, under a centered headline
ad_info.angle_used: Beneficio sin sacrificio: tus curvas sin agujas ni quirófano

global_identity.color_palette: Brand palette: hot fuchsia #E6177F (main accent), deep magenta #B0105E, dark plum #2B1226, bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, pale blush pink #FBE3EE and white #FFFFFF. For this variation: a dark plum to deep magenta background gradient, a deep magenta arch, fuchsia icon tiles and white texts.
global_identity.visual_style: Bold, feminine premium supplement ad with the real bottle as the hero, sharp and identical to the photo.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Confident, calm and trustworthy, with a soft fuchsia glow.
global_identity.graphic_language: A tall arch panel with a rounded top, solid rounded-square fuchsia tiles with white line icons, one small rounded pill, clean high-contrast typography readable on a phone, smooth background with no texture.
global_identity.text_typography: Headline in a very heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat ExtraBold / Black look), uppercase; benefits in a rounded bold sans-serif (Poppins SemiBold / Bold look).

creative_objective: Contrast with the operating room: curves the natural way, without needles or surgery. The real bottle framed by the arch and four honest benefits prove the promise in three seconds.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The headline. 2) The bottle framed by the arch on the left. 3) The four benefits on the right, top to bottom. 4) The small registration pill under the benefits.
art_direction.composition_style: Asymmetric two-column grid under a centered full-width headline. Left column (6-50% of the width): tall arch with the bottle in front. Right column (54-94% of the width): four benefit rows and, under them, the small registration pill.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Headline 6-21% of the height, centered, up to 88% of the width. Arch about 10-46% of the width and 28-94% of the height, fully rounded top. Bottle centered on the arch, base at about 90% of the height, about 50-56% of the canvas height. Four benefit rows evenly spaced between about 28% and 82% of the height, each about 12% tall; tiles about 9% of the canvas starting at about 54% of the width, text from about 66% to 94%. Registration pill about 54-94% of the width and 86-92% of the height.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Soft studio light from the upper left; the bottle casts a soft contact shadow at the base of the arch and has a thin fuchsia rim light. The arch has a very subtle vertical gradient and a faint shadow. Tiles and text are flat, without shadows.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Square canvas with a smooth dark plum to deep magenta gradient. A bold centered white headline spans the top with the word 'QUIRÓFANO' in bubblegum pink. Left half: a tall deep magenta arch with a rounded top and the real bottle standing large in front of it. Right half: four benefit rows stacked with equal spacing, each a solid fuchsia rounded-square tile with a white line icon followed by a short bold white benefit. Under the benefits, a small rounded registration pill. No other elements.
